question: In what spirit may a person recite this text and still gain its benefit?
premises: Recitation may be done with playfulness.
Recitation may be done with sportiveness.
Any person who recites it in such a manner is included.
inference: Even playful or sportive recitation by a person is accepted as valid recitation of this text.
plain_english: Any person who recites this, whether playfully or sportively, is included.
